## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 6, 2026 - Jul 30, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Faruwae_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "I don’t usually write reviews on App Store or really in general but this stuff has been annoying me and now it’s gotten too far. I just got the age verification thing. It doesn’t even work. When I verify my age the exact way it tells me to, I’m trapped in reading mode, where I’m forced to sit and read the same things over and over again. I seriously don’t know how they think doing this will help people’s mental health/state. This is making it worse. As someone who has a horrible life outside of online, I have nothing to do anymore. It’s already hard for us to get jobs. Even if I got one, it isn’t fun or entertaining. I can’t put characters into what I imagine anymore. The other updates are absolute trash as well. Anyone who gives this app above a 2 star, is generally glazing it from the past. It used to be so good before we got the new owner. This old man should retire already. Ruining the app entirely. If you’re going to do age verification to make the app mostly 18+ when you don’t even allow nsfw content and it’s supposed to be 12+, you have serious issues with your brain. I really hate how this app is turning out. The age verification is the same as Roblox, using Persona, something known for leaking info. They took our mouths. They took our hands. They took our ideas to put to use. They trapped us away from something we loved. They removed our thoughts. They made us feel unwelcome. They don’t care about us. They want a good reputation but are still ruining it. We need to give 1 star reviews only like this app deserves."
            2. _Maxhatesthisapp_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "I remember when every feature on the app used to be free, now the app is basically unusable if you don’t pay for a £10 MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTION, STOP TAKING AWAY FEATURES FOR FREE USERS TO MAKE C.AI+ SEEM BETTER"
            3. _Rainn Wright_, Jul 27, 2026, 1/5: "They turned it into Tiktok. What is this? First it censored everything, then ads, now it makes you verify your identity by showing your face & id, and they got rid of the bot recommendations and replaced it with Tiktok adjacent. Used to be good, now its almost unusable."
